notes: NovaShell’s compact player is now a single renderer instead of several overlapping animation loops, preserving Pixel Field clarity while cutting idle work.
changes: Orbit no longer loads three legacy Pixel Field scripts that were repainting the same mini-player canvas.
The retained dense Pixel Field pass sleeps between checks whenever the compact player is not visible.
The current release retains deterministic Relay/Orbit window focus, manual update checks, and the protected Relay workspace smoke-test result.
